//: Type-checks the files the EMITTING build excludes, so none of them sits outside every program. A file outside `include` is removed from the program and can never report an error — which is how a broken drizzle.config.ts reaches `db:generate` instead of a type-checker. The glob is `src/**/__tests__/**`, not `src/__tests__/**`: tests live beside the code they cover (`src/db/__tests__`, `src/routes/__tests__`), and a narrower glob would leave every one of them checked by nothing while `bun run typecheck` still passed. eslint.config.mjs is JavaScript and is covered by `bun run lint` instead. noEmit + composite:false because this project only reads; `bun run build` still emits from tsconfig.json alone.
